summary: UTime Limited (Cayman Islands) filed a Form 6-K furnishing Notice of an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for September 10, 2026, along with a proxy card. The meeting agenda includes four proposals: (1) increasing authorized share capital to create additional Class A and B shares; (2) subdividing par value shares to vastly increase share count; (3) adopting a Fourth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association; and (4) authorizing a reverse share consolidation of Class A shares within a 1:10 to 1:100 ratio. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic transaction is described; this is a routine capital-structure housekeeping notice.
